name: Pearl Jam

whyMatters.en: Seattle grunge band that outlasted the early-90s boom as a touring and Ticketmaster-fight institution; Ten (1991) remains the mass entry.
whyMatters.zh: 西雅图 grunge：在 90 年代初热潮后仍以巡演与 Ticketmaster 抗争体制存续；Ten（1991）仍是大众入口。

note.en: Ten-era opener: Vedder baritone, McCready lead, open-chord grind.
note.zh: Ten 时期开场：Vedder 男中音、McCready 主音、开放和弦碾磨。

note.en: Narrative video single; MTV-scale Ten face.
note.zh: 叙事录像单曲；MTV 尺度的 Ten 面孔。

note.en: Funk-tinged riff; live staple from debut cycle.
note.zh: 带放克味 riff；首专周期现场常备。

interviewQuotes.text: I would rather be someone's backup singer than a rock star.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Eddie Vedder

interviewQuotes.text: We just wanted to play music.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Stone Gossard
interviewQuotes.source: On post–Mother Love Bone start · interview

lyricQuotes: Son, she said, have I got a little story for you

shortBio.en: Vedder / McCready / Gossard Ten-era grunge; Alive and Jeremy are the mass entry.
shortBio.zh: Vedder / McCready / Gossard 的 Ten 时期 grunge；Alive 与 Jeremy 是大众入口。

body.en:
Formed 1990 from Green River/Mother Love Bone fragments with Eddie Vedder. Ten and Vs. made them stadium-scale alongside Nirvana/Soundgarden; Vitalogy onward tracked a longer career arc.

Alive (1991) is the essential-track marker here. Musically: open chords, McCready leads, Vedder’s baritone. Institutionally: anti-scalping fights and bootleg-heavy touring culture.
body.zh:
1990 年由 Green River/Mother Love Bone 碎片与 Eddie Vedder 组建。Ten 与 Vs. 使其与 Nirvana/Soundgarden 同级体育场体量；Vitalogy 起进入更长职业弧线。

Alive（1991）是此处必听标记。音乐上：开放和弦、McCready 主音、Vedder 男中音。制度上：反黄牛斗争与重现场录音的巡演文化。

title.zh: Ten 作为体育场 grunge 入口

body.en:
Ten (1991) puts Pearl Jam on MTV and rock radio beside Nirvana and Soundgarden. Open chords, Vedder baritone, McCready leads. They outlast the early-90s boom as a touring institution.

Ticketmaster fight becomes part of the institutional story.
body.zh:
Ten（1991）把 Pearl Jam 推到 MTV 与摇滚电台，与 Nirvana、Soundgarden 并列。开放和弦、Vedder 男中音、McCready 主音。他们以巡演体制撑过 90 年代初热潮。

Ticketmaster 抗争成为制度故事的一部分。

body.en:
Vedder, McCready, Gossard, Ament, and Krusen cut Ten. Drum chair rotates later (Abbruzzese, Irons, Cameron); the guitar/vocal core stays.

Citation peak remains the debut five for radio memory.
body.zh:
Vedder、McCready、Gossard、Ament 与 Krusen 录 Ten。鼓席后期轮换（Abbruzzese、Irons、Cameron）；吉他/人声核心保留。

电台记忆的引用峰值仍是首专五人。

body.en:
Alive opens with family-story lyric and McCready solo. Jeremy pairs narrative video with mid-tempo grind. Even Flow keeps the live riff staple.

Ten supplies the whole mass curriculum in one cycle.
body.zh:
Alive 以家庭故事歌词与 McCready 独奏开场。Jeremy 把叙事录像与中速碾磨配对。Even Flow 保持现场 riff 常备。

Ten 在同一周期提供整套大众课程。

title.en: Baritone, Les Paul leads, Gossard rhythm
title.zh: 男中音、Les Paul 主音、Gossard 节奏

body.en:
Vedder’s baritone sits forward. McCready supplies blues-rock leads. Gossard and Ament bring Mother Love Bone/Green River rhythm DNA.

Less quiet-loud than Nirvana; more open-chord hard rock weight.
body.zh:
Vedder 男中音靠前。McCready 提供蓝调摇滚主音。Gossard 与 Ament 带入 Mother Love Bone/Green River 节奏 DNA。

强弱动态少过 Nirvana；更偏开放和弦 hard-rock 重量。

body.en:
Vedder’s backup-singer line and Gossard’s play-music claim document early-90s posture beside stadium scale.

Read against Ten’s radio saturation—not as contradiction to erase.
body.zh:
Vedder 的「宁可当和声」句与 Gossard「只想弹琴」主张，记录体育场体量旁的 90 年代初姿态。

对照 Ten 的电台饱和阅读——不当成要抹掉的矛盾。

body.en:
Vs., Vitalogy, and later albums extend the career. Bootleg culture and anti-scalping fights matter as institutional tech. Seattle peers fragment; Pearl Jam keeps the touring machine.

Influence is durability as much as tone.
body.zh:
Vs.、Vitalogy 与后期专辑延长职业线。现场录音文化与反黄牛是制度技术。西雅图同辈分裂；Pearl Jam 保持巡演机器。

影响既是音色，也是耐久。

note.en: Debut album citation lineup; Krusen exits after Ten.
note.zh: 首专引用阵容；Krusen 在 Ten 后离队。

note.en: Soundgarden drummer joins; long touring stability.
note.zh: Soundgarden 鼓手加入；长期巡演稳定。

note.en: Ten-era mass entry; baritone over open-chord grind.
note.zh: Ten 时期大众入口；男中音压在开放和弦碾磨上。

note.en: Stadium grunge that becomes a touring institution.
note.zh: 成为巡演体制的体育场 grunge。
